title: achnatherum pekinense subsp. pubicalyx
intro: Achnatherum pekinense subsp. pubicalyx, commonly known as the 'Peking wild rice' or 'Chinese wild rice', is a plant species in the grass family. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Achnatherum pekinense subsp. pubicalyx are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, although further research is needed to confirm its full range of bioactive compounds.
